title: Event Recap: Siggraph Asia 2024 In Tokyo
description:
SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 in Tokyo 

This year at SIGGRAPH Asia, we had an incredible time connecting with developers, students, researchers, and our dedicated Marvelous Designer users. Thank you for visiting our booth and sharing your inspiring stories with us! Here's a quick recap of the event in Tokyo!

summary: # Event Recap: Siggraph Asia 2024 In Tokyo ## Introduction to MyRose Designer MyRose Designer is a 3D design software mainly for environment design, and it is widely used in the gaming, VFX, and animation industries. ## Purpose of Attending Siggraph The reason we wanted to attend Siggraph is not only to share our newest features and the technical aspects of the software but also to connect with our users. We aim to gather as much feedback as possible while also sharing the excitement for the features that our users love the most. ## Booth Activities At our booth, we have a demo station where attendees can experience our software firsthand. ### Presentations and Demos We also have talks where participants can listen to presentations about the newest features we developed. ### Tying Mouth Challenge In addition, we are hosting the exciting Tying Mouth Challenge to demonstrate how easy it is for users to learn how to use Siggraph or utilize Marvelous Designer software.
